svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 17 (CUMULATIVE R497) · LIVE-CODE PRD ANCHORS, SINGLE-DEP HARNESS & FAILOVER
pmprd (data-prd <-> #anchor) + UH-Universal-Harness (1 Dep) + Haven Failover + herdr-plugins
1. xinyuefangfang/pmprd (★23 · 2 forks · 127.0.0.1:7790)
• Extracts Real Source UI + Bidirectional data-prd <-> {#anchor}
Preserves existing frontend components (never redraws from screenshots)
Replaces API/auth/payment with local in-memory mock data alongside Markdown PRD
2. Antoine-Thomas/UH-Universal-Harness (★21 · 1 Dep httpx · MIT)
• Synchronous max_iterations-bounded loop + strict schema-checked toolsets
• Deterministic 4-tier cascade: Ollama local ➔ Cloudflare ➔ DeepSeek ➔ local gateway
• Built-in MCP client, persisted sessions & night-pass note consolidation
• Only 1 runtime dependency (httpx); zero account or API key needed on first launch
3. Bluezip231/Haven-Public (★24 · 23 forks · Failover Pattern)
• Mid-Conversation Claude-to-Codex Shared-Browser Failover
Audits completed actions before retry & hands off the same Playwright Chrome profile
Approval Cards for writes + Git worktree self-update with supervisor auto-rollback
4. digitaltracer/herdr-plugins (★23 · 5 forks · MIT)
• Unified Herdr Inbox: blocked agents, Slack asks, failed CI & GitHub reviews (free gh)
• Haiku Linear checks (~1¢/run); expensive Sonnet sweeps (30-45¢/run) OFF by default
• Pre-checks connector sign-in state so scheduled runs wait instead of paying to fail
• Displays live daily dollar cost estimate directly in the Settings dialog
💰 CLOSED-FORM FINOPS BENCHMARK (CLAIM-20261118-R17-PMPRD-UHHARNESS-HAVEN-HERDRCC · 45 SEATS)
• Path A (Redrawn Mockups + Unbounded Cron + Browser Reset Retries): $2,160.00 spend + $3,800.00 labor (38.0h) = $5,960.00 / mo
• Path B (Manual Mock Branches + Separate Dashboards): $920.00 spend + $1,550.00 labor (15.5h) = $2,470.00 / mo
• Path C (pmprd + uh-harness + Haven + herdr-plugins): $75.00 tokens + $270.00 labor (2.7h) = $345.00 / mo (-$5,615.00/mo · -94.21%)
